title: Democratic share of the two-party vote by Hispanic origin group (ecological estimates)
notes: Estimates for places, not counts of how people voted: a regression of tract (2016, 2020, 2024) or county (2022) results on the group make-up of citizen adults.
Every Hispanic-origin value is moved by one cycle-level shift so the national Hispanic figure equals the CES validated-voter figure; the interval adds the error measured against CES cells.
Groups with fewer than 25,000 citizen adults in a region are left out: their estimate is mostly the prior.
sources: ACS 5-year B03001, B05003, B05003I, B03002 (Census Bureau)
Precinct results reallocated to tracts: Fekrazad, doi:10.7910/DVN/Z8TSH3 (CC0)
County results: MEDSL and state officials (unified/results_county)
